I went to the clinic to have three teeth removed under crowns. I already had swelling and inflammation. I want to highlight the staff member Alina—she was very pleasant and attentive. The doctor and nurse were professional, and the nurse was supportive even when it was painful. Everything was done quite quickly.

An important point for those with inflammation: I mentioned that I don't tolerate adrenaline well, and they ruled it out. However, in such cases, anesthesia is weaker and wears off faster. I wasn't warned about this, and the stitches were very painful, so they had to administer more anesthetic. So my advice: if you have inflammation, don't rule out adrenaline without discussing it with your doctor.

Otherwise, I had a positive experience with the clinic and highly recommend it.
